Due to the weight of this item, it will require assistance with unloading & moving at point of delivery.

Drop-forged and heat-treated for exceptional strength and durability. Ideal for general wrecking and demolition work. Features bevelled nail remover for prying embedded nails and wide, low-profile claw for easier penetration and more effective prying. Powder-coated finish and polished tips offer greater resistance to corrosion.
b: Black Powder-Coated Finish with Polished Tip
